name: Chronicle
card: Every decision, yes or no, is a public NEP-297 event with an explorer link.

name: Town Hall
card: File a real proposal from your own charter and see the open proposals at /shops/hall/.

name: Mist Bank
role: vault · amounts stay in the mist
card: Amounts stay hidden. Public: the check passed, and when.

name: Ferry
card: A live 1Click quote with its signature checked; your charter pays a testnet stand-in.

name: Guardhouse
card: Every spend is checked before it can be signed: payee list, daily cap, weekly cap.

name: Vault Arena
card: A live vault anyone may try to break. Every failed attack is a Chronicle row.

name: House
card: Only your house key can change the oath or ring the curfew. The agent holds a propose-only key.

name: Toll Bridge
card: Pay 0.01 NEAR from your own charter; the gate then gets the MPC network to sign a Base Sepolia payout, and settles it with a foreign-tx proof.

name: Payouts
role: counting house · one batch, all or nothing
card: List 2 to 5 payouts. Your charter pays them all in one tx, or refuses all of them.
